pages.text: Dig a small pool, ring it with flowers, and throw in a diamond.$(br2)The Twilight Forest has to be taken in order.

Lands you haven't earned will curse you until the boss before them is dead: the Naga and the Lich, the Minoshroom and the Hydra, the Knight Phantoms and the Ur-Ghast, the Alpha Yeti and the Snow Queen.$(br2)A $(l:realms/twilight#magic_map)Magic Map$(/l) shows the way.
Fiery blood from the Hydra plus iron.
